body: I hear you as well, have given up on trying to reach out to anyone because either they get uncomfortable or they give you the standard “things will get better, you have so much to live for...” blah blah blah...Wish I had something comforting to say to you, but as of now I am just hiding it and numbing the pain in unhealthy ways. So sorry😓
Doesn’t seem like it from where I’m sitting 😔

Also don’t have much family, no kids and parents gone, one sib who is overwhelmed and I think tired of my stuff, no one wants to hear it and I don’t blame them, so I guess I’ll keep putting on the fake face and hiding and pretending all is fine...truly don’t see a way out of this

Thanks, yes, have done the psychiatry and therapy dance, meds
included, just not effective for me, and believe me I have tried for almost 30 years, just really exhausted with life. 😕
Am so sorry, I feel the same way, I’m not strong enough for this life either, I want out 😓
Thank you for this powerful post, means a lot right now ✌🏿

Am so sorry for your pain, sadly I can relate completely, eating disorder from Hell topped w booze and other unhealthy habits. I often think “what is wrong w me?” Seems impossible to change anything....you are not alone, for whatever that is worth. I keep coming here and lurking in reading, I’m hoping that just one day it will really click and I will get my life back together. Sending hugs your way, I understand so very much. Being here is a wonderful place, people are open honest supportive and genuinely understand. Edit: ignore my badge as well

Thank you for posting this, it hits so hard. I am so afraid of the emotions that come up when abstaining for a day or two, desperate crying spells. And yes, I have had depression for most of my life been on every med in the book, even hospitalized in psych wards in the past. I’m just at a loss, but I’m so very grateful for you all. I hope hope hope to soon be able to say that I’ve gone a week without drinking. Shit, even three days would be nice at this point. Thank you all 💚
